note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot. Plan sizes from the trace of the straight front photo (42 mm case, listing; strap 21.1 mm measured, not listed). Heights before the house depth scale. Dial print, applied numerals, pulsometer flange and the strap leather come from one photo map.

case.note: (r, z): polished flank rounding into the wide polished bezel (19.26-21 mm in the photo); inner lip covers the flange edge

lug.note: stepped polished lugs: outer block, and a step 1 mm lower next to the strap (split at the traced step_x)

dial.note: flat dial to the flange's inner edge, then the pulsometer flange as a cone up to the bezel lip

strap.note: House curl (SUR419P1): bend at the lug tips (23.9 mm), 7 mm radius, end_y = tip + 2.2 x radius

gold.note: pins in the centre and sub-dial hubs

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers blur the dial behind transmission glass
